task.description:
Design and finalize SCH-03 test coverage for timer cancellation behavior, aligned to the current backend implementation.

Read SCH-03 acceptance criteria in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md and scheduler design context before modifying tests.

Ensure test coverage includes:
- atomic cancellation of all PENDING timers when instance becomes COMPLETED or CANCELLED
- guarantee that CANCELLED timers are not fired by SCH-02 polling
- race behavior documentation/coverage for fire-vs-cancel first-commit-wins rule
- explicit non-impact on already FIRED timers

Update or add test specs and test files under tests/specs and tests/integration as needed.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
acceptance_criteria: SCH-03 acceptance criteria are mapped to explicit test cases
tests/specs/SCH-03.md exists or is updated with traceable cases
Integration tests cover atomic cancellation and scheduler non-fire behavior for CANCELLED timers

result.summary: Test specs and integration coverage for SCH-03 finalized. Added tests/specs/SCH-03.md with explicit traceability and extended tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig with SCH-03 cases for completion/cancellation atomic timer cancellation, non-fire guarantees for CANCELLED timers, first-commit-wins ordering outcomes, and non-impact on already FIRED timers.
